name: rachael-quisel-skills
description: Private, maintained agent plugins from Rachael Quisel.

plugins.name: skillkeeper
plugins.description: Maintain your agent skills with named owners, repeatable tests, compatibility evidence, update and rollback records, and verified failure alerts.

plugins.name: automation-briefing
plugins.description: Get a short, plain-English brief on automation tools and leading AI models. See what changed, why it matters, and what to test, change, or watch.

plugins.name: zite-prompt
plugins.description: Write short, paste-ready Zite prompts. Resolve facts outside Zite, use known IDs, and focus each prompt on the next build step.

plugins.name: automation-catalog
plugins.description: Creates a name, guide, run location, and tags for each automation.

plugins.name: automation-catalog-failure-check
plugins.description: Check for missing automation catalog reports. Send known failures and blockers to an approved channel.

plugins.name: client-docs
plugins.description: Write, diagram, and publish the canonical documents for an XRAY client build, plus the how-it-works, education, KPI, business case, SOAP, and branded-doc skills around it, the five-signals PRD, and the build plan, plus task fetching and meeting transcript review. 26 skills.

plugins.name: humanize-output
plugins.description: Improve existing copy through a short conversation. Choose the reader, tone, and editing depth. Review suggestions before applying changes.

plugins.name: adhd-task-helper
plugins.description: ADHD-friendly support for clearer replies, starting a task, sorting a brain dump, and resuming interrupted work.

plugins.name: airtable-interface-craft
plugins.description: Create distinctive Airtable interfaces with verified data, reliable interactions and an exact source return.

plugins.name: workflow-diagram-builder
plugins.description: Explain a workflow with a Mermaid diagram. Answer a few questions, see who does each step, and revise the diagram through conversation.

plugins.name: automate-notification-to-teams
plugins.description: Set up Microsoft Teams notifications through a few questions.

plugins.name: automation-message-writer
plugins.description: Interactively turn automation results into finished interface messages that nontechnical clients understand.

plugins.name: find-automatable-workflows
plugins.description: Ask a few questions to find work worth automating. Review selected sources and turn a chosen recommendation into a specification with outcome checks.

plugins.name: generate-financial-dummy-data
plugins.description: Create test grants through a conversation. Answer a few questions about your destination and test scenario. Receive verified records or an import file.

plugins.name: ghibli-icon-maker
plugins.description: Give your ideas a softer look. Draws hand-made charcoal line icons on washed pastel tiles, so a set of plugins, apps, or brand marks reads as one family instead of a pile of clip art.

plugins.name: plain-english-editor
plugins.description: Rewrite or review content in concise, plain English, including automation and process explanations.

plugins.name: publish-a-plugin
plugins.description: Prepare Claude Code plugins for directory review.

plugins.name: questions-worth-asking
plugins.description: Turn meeting notes into useful follow-up. Find missed questions, clarify what changed, and get a prioritized checklist with messages ready to use.

plugins.name: skill-and-plugin-namer
plugins.description: Name a skill or plugin through a few questions. Receive a clear name, tagline, description, feature bullets, and usage steps.

plugins.name: turn-off-ai-data-sharing
plugins.description: Find out what your AI accounts are actually sharing, then shut off the parts you never agreed to. Reads the settings pages in your own browser, checks each one against what the vendor documents, and hands you the exact click path to fix it.

plugins.name: week-in-rewind
plugins.description: Create a short recap of opted-in Computer History. Choose the dates, tone, and focus. Optional scheduling supports delivery to your own Slack direct message.

plugins.name: worth-asking
plugins.description: Surface high-leverage questions missed in client conversations.

plugins.name: airbnb-hosting-expert
plugins.description: Practical Airbnb hosting guidance, listing reviews, and guest-message drafts based on the host's confirmed details.

plugins.name: github-portfolio-builder
plugins.description: Build a stronger GitHub portfolio. Highlight your best work, explain your contributions, and get a prioritized plan for what to improve.

plugins.name: github-portfolio-review
plugins.description: Review GitHub projects as credible professional portfolio evidence.

plugins.name: contact-follow-up-tracker
plugins.description: Save contacts, encounters, and confirmed promises in a Google Drive log. Check who owes what to whom and when. Enable Cowork reminders when you choose.

plugins.name: cited-research-assistant
plugins.description: Research questions and check drafts with retrieved evidence. Cite each supported claim. Identify evidence gaps. Check the final reply against the cited brief.
